@JavascriptInterface
public void scanBarcode() {
    try {
        MainActivity.this.runOnUiThread(new Runnable() { public void run() {
            try { new com.google.zxing.integration.android.IntentIntegrator(MainActivity.this).setPrompt("Scan").setBeepEnabled(false).setOrientationLocked(true).initiateScan(); } catch (Exception e) {}
        }});
    } catch (Exception e) {}
}
